verdict.rationale: Leaving is possible: the API lets you read and toggle the transfer lock and manage transfers, and community users report moving dozens of domains out. Data can be pulled out piecemeal through read APIs (DNS records, customers, store info) in JSON, but no bulk or full-account export is documented, and one report says GoDaddy blocked WHOIS lookups to slow transfers out. missing for 10: documented bulk/full-account data export, open-format exports such as DNS zone files, a documented end-to-end transfer-out/offboarding guide, independent confirmation that exit is frictionless
